scope: Pipeline official preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper interactions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Pipeline preset listing View demo opened Pipeline Clean demo storefront.

claims.observed: All collection displays product-type, color, size, fabric, fit, price and availability facets, with sorting and grid-density controls; PDP shows sizing guide, fabric/care details and related-product offers.
claims.risk: Visible controls and content do not prove shopper behavior or merchant-data accuracy.
claims.vsn_guard: Test filtering, responsive grid, sizing and recommendations in actual shopper flows; validate product metadata.

claims.observed: Demo shows low-stock copy, free-shipping threshold, shipping/returns content, textile composition and sustainability language.
claims.risk: Sample inventory and merchant claims are not verified by rendered page text.
claims.vsn_guard: Connect availability and shipping thresholds to live authoritative values and substantiate material and sustainability claims.
